tells: 1. The laugh never builds: across 0.2 s steps only a sip, a hand lift and a couple of head turns; no shoulders, no torso pitch, no mouths opening together, so nothing reads as caused by a line (club-5-strip.png, all six frames, front two tables)

2. Wide and held frames are near-identical: same poses, same heads, same hands on tables; the front row looks parked, mannequin-still, all with hands folded on tabletops (club-1-wide.png vs club-6-held.png, front row centre)

3. Close-up face is waxy game-engine skin with flat specular, painted eyes and a dark DOF fringe outlining the jacket collar and shoulder against the bokeh (club-4-face.png, face centre and shoulder edge right)
4. Back rows are unlit standing cut-out silhouettes with uniform heads at one height, reading as cardboard stand-ins; no seats or tables under them (club-1-wide.png, middle band y 290-400)
5. Lower third is a black void with lower legs fading into nothing and a hard black bar; far-right figures float with no floor contact (club-1-wide.png, bottom band and right edge x 1150-1280)

1. Lighting is a hard rectangular pool on two rows; everyone beyond it drops to flat black cut-outs against haze, like a spotlit diorama rather than a house with stage spill (theatre-1-wide.png, rows above y 330 and side blocks)

2. Stiff, upright, identical seated poses with hands on knees across the front row; people at the far sides stand bolt upright in the aisles/rows with arms hanging (theatre-1-wide.png, front row centre and figures at x 100 and x 1190)

3. Face close is plastic: helmet hair, blank glassy eyes that do not match the open-mouth laugh, plus a dark ring halo around the hood and jaw from the DOF composite (theatre-4-face.png, eyes and hood edge)
4. Back-row silhouettes are flat sprite impostors with crisp identical outlines and no seat geometry, popping against the haze; flare dots float in the void (theatre-2-mid.png, top band y 0-200)
5. Laugh onset reads but many mouths open at the same frame (t=12.6-12.8) while bodies stay still; the hoodie lean at t=13.0 is the only body response (theatre-5-strip.png, front row frames 4-6)

1. Stair-stepped aliasing and a comb/scanline artefact on the hair edge, with a dark smeared outline around the neck and shoulder where DOF meets the subject (openmic-4-face.png, hair right side x 800-870 y 200-340, collar)

2. Dark halos ring every in-focus figure against the blurred background (bun, ear, yellow-shirt shoulder, hoodie), a classic depth-of-field compositing error (openmic-6-held.png, edges of all three subjects)

3. Crowd is packed into a tight wedge, bodies overlapping and interpenetrating, with pink lower legs like stilts under the brown-haired woman and knees missing chairs (openmic-1-wide.png, centre x 700-800 y 560-700)

4. Flat even fill on the front rows with no motivated key from the stage; the back figures are black standing silhouettes, and a stray green dot floats on the wall (openmic-1-wide.png, middle band and x 700 y 230; openmic-3-mid.png x 250 y 180)

5. The two laughing women carry the strip while neighbours barely move; laugh starts with a whole-body head jerk at t=12.6 rather than a build (openmic-5-strip.png, green shirt and hoodie, frames 3-5)
